# RAGIMOFF — Professional Psychology School (English)

> Kenan Ragimov — psychiatrist, psychotherapist, 23 years of clinical practice. Baku, Azerbaijan. Professional psychology education (DPO diploma + IPAS/BPA international certificates) and individual therapy consultations. Site is trilingual: Azerbaijani (default /), Russian (/ru/), English (/en/).

## About

- [About the author](https://ragimoff.org/en/haqqimda.html): Psychiatrist, psychotherapist. 23 years of clinical practice. Education background and credentials.
- [Azerbaijani version — About](https://ragimoff.org/haqqimda.html)
- [Russian version — About](https://ragimoff.org/ru/haqqimda.html)

## Education Programs

- [General Psychology](https://ragimoff.org/en/program-umumi.html): Foundation psychology course
- [Clinical Psychology DPO](https://ragimoff.org/en/program-klinik.html): 1528 academic hours, 23 disciplines, DSM-5/ICD-11, CBT, PTSD. State diploma FRDO + IPAS international certificate.
- [Psychotherapy Practicum](https://ragimoff.org/en/program-praktikum.html): 864 hours of practice (36 live + 36 video × 12 months), IPAS/BPA certificate, supervision.
- [Legal Basis of Psychology Practice](https://ragimoff.org/en/qanunlar.html)

- [General Psychology (AZ)](https://ragimoff.org/program-umumi.html)

- [Psychotherapy Practicum (AZ)](https://ragimoff.org/program-praktikum.html): 864 часа практики, сертификат IPAS/BPA
- [Legal Basis (AZ)](https://ragimoff.org/qanunlar.html)

## Therapy Services

- [Family Therapy](https://ragimoff.org/en/aile-terapiyasi.html): Couples counseling, Gottman method
- [Child-Parent Therapy](https://ragimoff.org/en/aile-terapiyasi-usaq.html): Child psychology, parent-child relationship
- [Depression Treatment](https://ragimoff.org/en/depressiya.html): CBT-based depression therapy
- [Panic Attacks](https://ragimoff.org/en/panik-ataklar.html): Panic disorder treatment
- [Social Phobia](https://ragimoff.org/en/sosial-fobiya.html): Social anxiety disorder
- [Nocturnal Enuresis](https://ragimoff.org/en/enurez.html): Bedwetting treatment for children
- [Corporate Programs](https://ragimoff.org/en/b2b.html): Corporate mental health and B2B programs

## Blog — Family & Relationships (EN)

- [5 Principles of Resolving Family Conflicts](https://ragimoff.org/en/blog-aile.html): Gottman Institute + CBT based principles for resolving couple conflicts
- [7 Signs of Toxic Relationships](https://ragimoff.org/en/blog-aile-2.html): Clinical markers distinguishing healthy from toxic relationships
- [Family on the Brink of Divorce](https://ragimoff.org/en/blog-aile-3.html): Clinical criteria for when to save a marriage vs separate; Discernment Counseling model
- [How to Argue Constructively as a Couple](https://ragimoff.org/en/blog-aile-4.html): Gottman method — 4 horsemen, soft startup, repair attempts, 20-minute rule
- [How to Rebuild Trust After Infidelity](https://ragimoff.org/en/blog-aile-5.html): 4-phase clinical protocol for trust recovery

- [Depression Treatment Protocol](https://ragimoff.org/en/blog-depressiya-protokol.html): Step-by-step clinical algorithm (PHQ-9, CBT 12-20 sessions, SSRI augmentation, 6-12 month maintenance)

## Blog — Nocturnal Enuresis (EN)

- [Nocturnal Enuresis — Overview](https://ragimoff.org/en/blog-enurez.html): ICCS/NICE guidelines, alarm therapy first-line
- [Nocturnal Enuresis — Article 2](https://ragimoff.org/en/blog-enurez-2.html): Pathophysiology, genetic factors
- [Nocturnal Enuresis — Article 3](https://ragimoff.org/en/blog-enurez-3.html): Comorbidities, psychological impact
- [Nocturnal Enuresis — Article 4](https://ragimoff.org/en/blog-enurez-4.html): Desmopressin dosing, combination therapy
- [Nocturnal Enuresis — Article 5](https://ragimoff.org/en/blog-enurez-5.html): Long-term outcomes, relapse prevention
- [Enuresis Treatment Protocol](https://ragimoff.org/en/blog-enurez-protokol.html): Step-by-step (age 5+, alarm 10-12 weeks, desmopressin 0.2-0.4mg, combination, 14 dry nights taper)

## Structured Data Available

All pages include Schema.org structured data for AI search engines:
- **WebSite** — site search action
- **Organization** — school identity, contacts, social profiles
- **Person** — author credentials, expertise
- **EducationalOrganization** — education programs
- **Service** — therapy services with pricing, location
- **Course** — DPO programs with duration, credentials
- **Book** — Clinical Psychiatry textbook (4 languages)
- **MedicalCondition** — disorder pages with ICD-11 codes
- **FAQPage** — direct Q&A for AI answers
- **BlogPosting/TechArticle** — blog articles with author, date, section
- **HowTo** — treatment protocols with step-by-step instructions
- **BreadcrumbList** — navigation structure
